race.comment: NAVY ROK (1) is a progressive type who was off the mark with an effortless maiden win two back then just edged out on the Parks track last time behind Maxildo. Tricky gate but will push forward and expected to go close. DIRTY DEAL (3) ran on well to score the maiden win two back then not far away here last time. Has the ability and drawn for a good run. HYSTERICAL LADY (12) has the ability but has to overcome the tricky draw. Will give a start but storm home, MRS PENNY CRACKER (13) is finding it hard to break through, finishing sixth last time out over 1400m at Morphettville Parks. Is ready to win after two runs back and will also be doing her best work late.
